findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-baseline-smoke.ts claims stale-artifact coverage but never seeds a stale final-report or stale lower-layer suite report. The only negative suite case at lines 443-469 covers malformed JSON, mixed-schema, and authority-overclaim; the claim cases at lines 471-513 cover missing lower layers and sequential unlock only. CHK-001/002/003/005/006 verificationEvidence says smoke verified stale rejection, but this required fail-closed path is untested and the recorded evidence overstates coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6d1fcae6: lattice-baseline-smoke now seeds real stale final-report and stale lower-layer suite cases, plus invalid status/local-stub/fresh-authorized lower-layer claim coverage. Verified on current story branch with npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke, npm test, and lattice validate allPass=true.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1171-1232 and 1277-1279 promote purely local baseline_run stub artifacts into engineering suiteStatus=PASS/authorization=authorized as soon as a development suite file exists. Repro: seed a PASS development baseline-suite-report.json, run baseline_run for each ENG-* id, then run node packages/main/dist/cli.js baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering --format=json; it returns PASS/authorized with no real engineering proof. That violates the documented boundary that Parallel Development is implementation-only and claim/proof unlock stays sequential (Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:28-31, 82-84), and Engineering suite PASS requires real runs plus maturity/rate checks (Lattice-Engineering-baseline.md:421-469), not local harness presence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6d1fcae6: baseline_suite_report now requires fresh non-local capabilityProof=true final reports and refuses localOnly/capabilityProof=false baseline_run artifacts, so local implementation diagnostics stay BLOCKED/not_authorized and cannot authorize Engineering suite PASS. Verified by lattice-baseline-smoke local-stub-suite scenario and lattice validate allPass=true.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1335 capability_claim_evaluate never authorizes an evidence-backed lower-layer claim. Even with seeded PASS suite reports for development+engineering, the command still returns authorized=false and authorizedClaimLevel=none while reporting highestEvidenceBackedClaim=engineering, so CHK-005 happy/edge behavior cannot succeed. Fix by deriving authorization/authorizedClaimLevel from the strongest satisfied lower-layer proof instead of hard-coding a permanent block for all targets.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6d1fcae6: capability_claim_evaluate now derives authorized/authorizedClaimLevel from a fresh sequential chain of suiteStatus=PASS, authorization=authorized, localOnly=false, capabilityProof=true lower-layer suite reports; production-safety still remains blocked without external receipt/multi-host/soak authority proof. Verified by fresh engineering claim and stale lower-layer claim smoke scenarios plus lattice validate allPass=true.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1045 parseFinalReport accepts any non-empty status string, so malformed final-report artifacts are not rejected. I seeded a full engineering layer where ENG-BUGFIX-1 used status="totally-wrong"; baseline_suite_report still returned suiteStatus=PASS and marked that artifact accepted. Fix by validating status against pass|blocked|failed|not_authorized before accepting the report, and refuse malformed status values fail-closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6d1fcae6: parseFinalReport now validates status against pass|blocked|failed|not_authorized and rejects outcome/status inconsistencies fail-closed. Verified by lattice-baseline-smoke invalid-status scenario and lattice validate allPass=true.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1074-1112 accepts a lower-layer baseline-suite-report as PASS proof without validating suite outcome coherence. readSuiteReport only checks schema/layer/staleness/suiteStatus=PASS/authorization=authorized/localOnly=false/capabilityProof=true, then evaluateCapabilityClaim at 1411-1442 upgrades highestAuthorizedClaim directly from that result. Repro: seed development baseline-suite-report.json with suiteStatus=PASS, authorization=authorized, capabilityProof=true, localOnly=false, but outcome=EXPECTED_BLOCK; seed a normal engineering suite report; then run `node packages/main/dist/cli.js capability_claim_evaluate --target=engineering --format=json`. Current output is authorized=true, outcome=PASS, authorizedClaimLevel=engineering even though the lower-layer proof artifact is internally contradictory. This is a false-PASS/false-authorization bug. Fix by making readSuiteReport fail closed on malformed or inconsistent suite outcome/state (at minimum reject non-PASS outcome when suiteStatus=PASS/authorization=authorized, and ideally validate the suite enum pair the same way parseFinalReport now validates outcome/status).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6d08cdca: readSuiteReport now validates suite report enum/coherence and rejects suiteStatus=PASS proofs unless outcome=PASS, authorization=authorized, capabilityProof=true, and localOnly=false. Added lattice-baseline-smoke regression for incoherent development suite outcome=EXPECTED_BLOCK otherwise authorized proof; verified build, lattice-baseline-smoke, command-ownership-contract, npm test, and lattice validate allPass=true.
